title: Allah Speaks to Moses in the Sacred Valley

paragraphs.text: When Moses came near the fire, a voice called him: "O Moses, I am your Lord. Take off your sandals, for you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa. I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed. I am Allah; there is no deity except Me. Worship Me and pray to remember Me. The Hour is surely coming. I almost hide it, so every soul is paid back for its efforts. Do not let one who denies it and follows his desire turn you away, or you would be ruined."

Allah asked what was in his right hand. Moses said it was his staff. He leaned on it, knocked down leaves for his sheep, and used it in other ways. Allah told him to throw it down. It became a snake, moving fast. Allah said, "Take it and do not fear. We will return it as it was." Then He told Moses to hold his hand to his side; it would come out white, with no illness. These were some of His greater signs.
Allah sent Moses to Pharaoh, who had gone beyond all limits. Moses prayed, "My Lord, open my chest for me, make my task easy, and untie the knot from my tongue."

hardWords.m: a job that must be done
a tight tie in a rope or string
